statement.p: Suppose that \displaystyle{U} (the universal set), \displaystyle{A} and \displaystyle{B} are sets, given as shown below.

Given a set \displaystyle{S}, \displaystyle{S}^{{c}} denotes the complement of \displaystyle{S}. Find each of the following sets. Enter your answer by listing the elements in increasing order, separated by commas. Do not put a comma after the last number. If the set is empty, enter DNE.
